E2E-74.finding: The only slow-client seam on main is the per-viewer unacked-frame bound - MAX_VIEWER_UNACKED = 64 at src/lib/multiplayer/server/projection/ViewerDeliveryCursors.ts:39, driven from e2e by installAckSwallow / driveUntilPlayer2Capped / VIEWER_UNACKED_CAP in e2e/helpers/viewerUnackedBound.ts and already used live by E2E-14 (e2e/gm-two-player-resilience.pack.spec.ts:588). That seam is on the TACTICAL match channel. The existing latency runner (ControlledLoopbackPerformanceRunner, driven by e2e/gm-two-player-performance.pack.spec.ts:109 via openCoopSession / joinGuestByRoomCode) measures the CAMPAIGN co-op channel, and grep for DeliveryAck / unacked / MAX_VIEWER_UNACKED over the campaign bind path returns nothing - the campaign channel has no ack-based queue bound to slow a client through.
E2E-74.consequence: Satisfying E2E-74 inside U1's ownership paths means porting a latency observer onto the TACTICAL channel (test-only, e2e/). Adding a campaign-channel send seam instead would be a src/ product change, OUTSIDE ownershipPaths.

A producer landing is what earns the second arm of the mapper'. src/lib/lifecycle/lifecycleState.ts:38-47 declares both projection signals as owned by add-authoritative-history-branches. E2E-76.finding: PK-rewind-branch-reader (units.json) asks whether matchStoreBranchSegmentReader should serve MATCH_BASELINE_BRANCH_ID alongside root, or the rewind mirror write onto root, 'given that the rewind-branch fold is unreachable for match streams today'. E2E-76.confirmHalfCheck: tasks.md 19.3 is [x] CLOSED (2026-09-02, Wave E7b): commitGmCombatRewind POSTs the previewed body to /api/matches/:id/rewind-commit, the dialog phrases committed/refused and disables confirm in flight, and the lobby passes both producers to the host surface. That same receipt ends 'NOT CLAIMED: the live three-browser row (E2E-76) is 22.3's'.
E2E-76.verdict: The confirm wiring does NOT by itself make the row green. Every locator the row uses (gm-rewind-preview-dialog, gm-rewind-preview-blast-radius, gm-rewind-preview-actions, gm-rewind-confirm, gm-rewind-cancel) is behind a SUCCESSFUL preview, and the preview route answers 404 without journaled combat history - on the unavailable path the dialog swaps to the phrasing body. Whether enough chrome still renders to satisfy the letter at the UI boundary cannot be settled without a live run, which is out of scope for this stage.
E2E-76.recommendation: Leave E2E-76 to the rewind-gated lane. Note for the parent: PK-rewind-branch-reader today holds 22.2@575 but NOT 22.3@584, so if E2E-76 is parked the packet's taskKeys (or a parked successor) must be the holder, or the holders rule leaves the row with no gate-aware owner.

E2E-77.gate: stale branch class - PK-rewind-branch-reader, same reader finding
E2E-77.finding: Five conflict classes. PROJECTION_REBUILDING is LIVE (src/lib/multiplayer/tacticalLifecycleState.ts:26-32: 'a real server refusal: the match stream refuses an engine-mutating intent while a correction lease rebuilds this match's history'). STALE_BRANCH is typed and wired but unreachable for match streams - the same reader defect PK-rewind-branch-reader names, plus rewind-pack finding #48. tasks.md 19.2@426 records 'STALE BRANCH and REBUILD are wired to the typed STALE_BRANCH / PROJECTION_REBUILDING codes and guarded unreachable until the branches leaf's admission gate (#1512) reaches a live command path'; 19.2@426 is ALREADY held by PK-rewind-branch-reader.
E2E-77.consequence: Four classes (stale revision, authorization, integrity, rebuild) are candidates today; stale branch is gated. Same shape as E2E-75: deliver the reachable subset, park the gated clause.

E2E-80.ciWiringCheck: .github/workflows/ holds auto-version.yml, camp01-live-adversarial.yml, nightly-validation.yml, pr-checks.yml, release.yml. grep for 'exact-main|exact main|post-merge' over .github/ returns NOTHING (every hit is under scripts/qc/camp01-*). pr-checks.yml triggers on pull_request to main; nightly-validation.yml on schedule + workflow_dispatch; camp01-live-adversarial.yml DOES trigger on push: branches: [main] - a post-merge exact-main-shaped job - but it runs the CAMP-01 authority receipt, not the gm-two-player staged three-context subset.
E2E-80.verdict: A CI job that reruns the staged subset on push to main would touch .github/, which is OUTSIDE U1's ownershipPaths (e2e, scripts/qc, the change dir). The scenario IS provable inside the paths without CI wiring: the milestone -> group ladder already exists as data in scripts/qc/gm-two-player-campaign-core.cjs (fixture-smoke before role admission, membership-smoke when roles land, the evolving `smoke` union thereafter), so a qc-level milestone/archive contract plus its pin in scripts/__tests__/gm-two-player-campaign-qc.test.ts asserts the selection and the archive path in-paths.
E2E-80.residualJudgement: Whether a declared-and-pinned contract satisfies the letter's 'SHALL rerun ... before the next dependent PR begins' as an ENFORCED gate, or whether the owner wants the .github/ job (a path amendment), is a judgement worth surfacing. tasks.md 24.4's own receipt already frames the per-merge discipline as 'a standing landing ritual'.

reasons: The full 22.3 seam measures 1000-1530 non-generated lines against a 500-line cap - 2x to 3x over. The 15-file cap is not the binding constraint (8 files).

Four of the ten scenarios are MISSING with no test row at all (E2E-74, E2E-75, E2E-77, E2E-80); two more are PARTIAL (E2E-76 is a declared strict expected failure, E2E-78 proves its gate but not the letter's 'any strict scenario' subject).

The gaps have DIFFERENT gate status, so one unit would mix ungated work with owner-gated work and stall on the gated half: E2E-74 and E2E-80 are ungated; E2E-75's `rewound` posture and E2E-77's stale-branch class are unreachable on main; E2E-76 is squarely behind PK-rewind-branch-reader.

Two gaps would need edits OUTSIDE ownershipPaths if taken the obvious way: a campaign-channel send seam for E2E-74 (src/) and a post-merge CI job for E2E-80 (.github/). Both have an in-paths alternative, which is what the split assumes - stating it so the parent can rule rather than letting a lane discover it mid-implementation.
